IS 6932 : Part 7 : 2025 Building Limes - Method of Test - Part 7 Determination of Compressive and Transverse Strengths
ICS 91.100.10
ICS 91.100.10
CED 04

1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 7) covers the methods of tests for determination of compressive and transverse strengths of building limes.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
